items.meaning_zh: v. 放弃；抛弃；离弃 n. 放纵
items.meaning_en: to leave someone or something behind completely, or to give up an idea or plan

examples.en: The owners abandoned the car on the highway after it broke down.
examples.zh: 车坏了之后,车主把它丢弃在了高速公路上。

examples.en: After months of losses, the company abandoned its plan to expand overseas.
examples.zh: 连续几个月亏损后,公司放弃了海外扩张的计划。

examples.en: She felt abandoned when all her friends moved away after graduation.
examples.zh: 毕业后朋友们都搬走了,她感到被抛弃了。

items.mnemonic_zh: a-(去)+ bandon(控制):脱离控制 → 放弃、抛弃。
items.image_alt_zh: 一辆被遗弃在荒野路边的锈迹斑斑的汽车

items.meaning_en: the physical or mental power to do something

examples.en: She has a remarkable ability to stay calm under pressure.
examples.zh: 她有一种在压力下保持冷静的非凡能力。

examples.en: Employers value the ability to work well in a team.
examples.zh: 雇主看重良好的团队合作能力。

examples.en: He did the job to the best of his ability.
examples.zh: 他竭尽所能把这份工作做好了。

collocations: to the best of one's ability
items.mnemonic_zh: 来自 able(能够)+ -ity(名词后缀),能够做某事的特质。
items.image_alt_zh: 一名学生专注地解开复杂的拼图

items.meaning_zh: adj. 反常的;不正常的;变态的
items.meaning_en: different from what is usual or expected, often in a worrying way

examples.en: The doctor ordered more tests because the results were abnormal.
examples.zh: 检查结果异常,医生又开了更多检查。

examples.en: Scientists say this summer's heat is abnormal for the region.
examples.zh: 科学家说,今年夏天的高温对该地区来说很反常。

examples.en: Please report any abnormal behavior on campus to security.
examples.zh: 校园内如有任何异常行为,请向保安报告。

items.mnemonic_zh: ab-(偏离)+ normal(正常)= 偏离正常 → 反常的。
items.image_alt_zh: 医生查看一张显示异常数据的心电图

items.meaning_zh: adv./prep. 在船(飞机、车)上;上船(车、飞机)
items.meaning_en: on or onto a ship, plane, train or bus

examples.en: All passengers were safely aboard the ferry before it left the dock.
examples.zh: 渡轮离港前,所有乘客都已安全上船。

examples.en: Welcome aboard! Please find your seat and fasten your seat belt.
examples.zh: 欢迎登机!请找到座位并系好安全带。

examples.en: We're glad to have you aboard as our new project manager.
examples.zh: 很高兴你加入我们团队,担任新的项目经理。

items.mnemonic_zh: a-(在…上)+ board(甲板、船舷)= 在船上。
items.image_alt_zh: 乘客们正沿着舷梯登上渡轮

items.meaning_en: to officially end a law, system or practice

examples.en: Many countries have abolished the death penalty in recent decades.
examples.zh: 近几十年来,许多国家已废除了死刑。

examples.en: The university decided to abolish its outdated attendance policy.
examples.zh: 大学决定废除过时的考勤规定。

examples.en: Activists called on the government to abolish single-use plastic bags.
examples.zh: 活动人士呼吁政府取缔一次性塑料袋。

items.mnemonic_zh: ab-(离开)+ ol(生长)→ 使不再生长 → 废除;与 abolition(废除)同源。
items.image_alt_zh: 一叠被红色印章盖上“废止”字样的旧文件

items.meaning_zh: adj. 突然的;唐突的;陡峭的
items.meaning_en: sudden and unexpected, or rude and short in manner

examples.en: The meeting came to an abrupt end when the power went out.
examples.zh: 停电时会议戛然而止。

examples.en: He was quite abrupt with me on the phone this morning.
examples.zh: 今早他在电话里对我很生硬冷淡。

examples.en: The road makes an abrupt turn just before the bridge.
examples.zh: 这条路在桥前突然急转弯。

items.mnemonic_zh: ab-(离开)+ rupt(断裂)= 突然断开 → 突然的。
items.image_alt_zh: 一条公路在悬崖边突然中断

items.meaning_en: the state of being away, or of not existing or being present

examples.en: Her absence from class last week worried her teachers.
examples.zh: 她上周缺课,让老师们很担心。

examples.en: In the absence of clear evidence, the case was dropped.
examples.zh: 由于缺乏明确证据,此案被撤销了。

examples.en: Absence makes the heart grow fonder, as the saying goes.
examples.zh: 俗话说,小别胜新婚(离别使感情更深)。

items.mnemonic_zh: ab-(离开)+ sence(是、在)= 不在场;与 present(在场)相对。
items.image_alt_zh: 教室里一张空着的课桌和椅子

items.meaning_zh: v. 吸收;吸引(注意力);承受
items.meaning_en: to take in a liquid, energy or information, or to hold someone's full attention

examples.en: Plants absorb sunlight and carbon dioxide to make food.
examples.zh: 植物吸收阳光和二氧化碳来制造养分。

examples.en: It takes time to absorb so much new information in a lecture.
examples.zh: 要消化讲座中这么多新信息需要时间。

examples.en: She was so absorbed in her novel that she missed her stop.
examples.zh: 她看小说看得入迷,坐过了站。

items.mnemonic_zh: ab-(离开)+ sorb(吸)= 吸走;sorb 同 sorbent 吸附剂。
items.image_alt_zh: 一块海绵把桌上的水完全吸干

items.meaning_zh: adj. 抽象的 n. 摘要;抽象画 v. 提取;摘要
items.meaning_en: existing as an idea rather than a physical thing; also a short summary of a paper

examples.en: Freedom is an abstract concept that people understand in different ways.
examples.zh: 自由是一个抽象概念,人们的理解各不相同。

examples.en: You must submit a 200-word abstract along with your research paper.
examples.zh: 提交研究论文时,须附上一份两百字的摘要。

examples.en: The gallery's new exhibit features bold abstract paintings by young artists.
examples.zh: 画廊的新展览展出了年轻艺术家大胆的抽象画作。

items.mnemonic_zh: abs-(离开)+ tract(拉)= 从具体事物中抽离出来 → 抽象。
items.image_alt_zh: 一幅由色块和线条组成的抽象画

examples.en: It's absurd to pay that much for a plain white T-shirt.
examples.zh: 花那么多钱买一件普通白T恤太荒唐了。

examples.en: The comedian's absurd jokes had the whole audience laughing.
examples.zh: 喜剧演员荒诞的笑话把全场观众都逗乐了。

examples.en: Don't be absurd; nobody is going to steal your old bike.
examples.zh: 别犯傻了,没人会偷你那辆旧自行车。

items.mnemonic_zh: ab-(完全)+ surd(耳聋的)→ 听不进道理 → 荒谬的。
items.image_alt_zh: 一只戴着太阳镜的猫坐在办公桌前
